test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The amount on a sum of ₹7,800 at 20% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Amount = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

= 7800 × (1.2)²

= 7800 × 1.44

**∴ Answer = ₹11,232**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P = 7800, r = 20%, n = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ A = 7800 × (1 + 20/100)²

⇒ = 7800 × (1.2)²

⇒ = 7800 × 1.44

⇒ = 11232

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,232.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest

Interest is calculated on both principal and accumulated interest

Growth Factor

(1 + r/100) gives multiplication factor each year

Shortcut

For 2 years: (1 + r/100)² = 1 + 2r/100 + (r/100)²

14
